title: Recognize Your Weakness, Strengthen Your Faith
main_theme: God does not require us to pretend to be strong; surrender weakness to Him.
summary: God's power is made perfect in weakness. Recognize it, surrender it, pray honestly and be transformed.
key_points: His power is made perfect in weakness
quotes: Think about that. God's power is not made perfect in your performance. It is made perfect in your weakness.
When your strength ends, His strength begins. That is not a slogan. That is the testimony of every saint who ever walked through the valley.

main_reels.caption: God does not need you to pretend.

encouragement_posts.headline: Let Go of Pretense: Embrace Your True Self
encouragement_posts.caption: God doesn’t need us to pretend. Let your true self shine, and see His strength in you.

encouragement_posts.headline: Honest Prayer: The Key to His Power
encouragement_posts.caption: Pray with sincerity, and watch His power transform your life.
